mode.title: Extraction Mode
mode.description: Data source mode: clinical_trials, fda_recalls, or fda_510k.

query.title: Search Query
query.description: General search keyword (trial term, recalled product, or 510(k) device name).

condition.title: Condition (Clinical Trials)
condition.description: Disease or condition for ClinicalTrials.gov v2 (e.g. "melanoma").

intervention.title: Intervention / Drug (Clinical Trials)
intervention.description: Drug or intervention name for ClinicalTrials.gov v2.

sponsor.title: Sponsor / Firm / Applicant
sponsor.description: Trial sponsor, recalling firm, or 510(k) applicant.

classification.title: FDA Recall Classification
classification.description: Optional recall class filter (e.g. "Class I", "Class II").

status.title: Status
status.description: Trial overall status (e.g. RECRUITING) or recall status (e.g. Ongoing).
